Donald Trump reportedly faced questions about his stance on UAP disclosure from UFO expert Dylan Borland. The former '1N1' geospatial intelligence specialist for the U.S. Air Force raised the question in a talk show, Hang Out with Sean Hannity. He also pointed out that if Trump doesn't disclose UFOs, then what might be the reason behind that? He wanted to know the answers. Dylan asked,

"When will he begin to discuss the reality of the situation?"

The TV host of Discovery+ UFO Witness Ben Hansen revealed that they don't have an official plan in place but have certain trusted agencies.

When Sean asked about the videos that highlighted the effort of whistleblowers, Ben said that his experience was different, but he still faced what the government does to people who join. He explained that it is very disappointing when someone signs up, whether for the military or another agency with the hope of serving and even speaking out when needed, but then faces mistreatment from inside.

Continue reading more about the story.

Donald Trump's UAP disclosure stance faced scrutiny from UFO experts

In Hang Out with Sean Hannity, former '1N1' geospatial intelligence specialist Dylan Borland reportedly raised a question on Donald Trump's UAP disclosure. He asked when Trump will begin to discuss the reality of the situation.

Ben explained that the UFO issue shows a bigger government problem, and removing that problem is a heavy burden. He thanked the person for carrying that weight and further admitted he didn't know how anyone could sleep at night with such responsibility.

Dylan explained that full disclosure would mean sharing details about the current abilities and technologies used in today's weapon systems. In addition, the act of disclosing full details about UAP would require exposing information about the systems and capabilities of other nations. Dylan said,

"I don't believe so, because full disclosure would have to include talking about current capabilities and technologies in our current weapon systems, as well as other nations."

Sean clarified that if Donald Trump understands this is true, then he also knows that the people trying to inform others are risking their lives. The show's host further explained that putting anyone's life on the line means facing threats of prosecution if the person reveals classified information. He finally added that such threats can place anyone's entire life on hold.
